title: OperationDef
description: Runtime metadata of one operation, version 1. Generated code passes it to the runtime library, which builds the request and parses the response from it (design.md 8.5, 18.9). A backend may emit it as a literal of its language; converted to JSON, it validates against this schema.

id.description: The operationId, or a name built from the method and path.

querystring.description: `in: querystring` (3.2): the whole query string as one value.

contents.description: Definition per media type. The first key is the default media type.

responses.description: Definition per status: a code such as 200, a range such as 2XX, or default.

security.description: Authentication alternatives, in order (OpenAPI `security`, resolved per operation). Each alternative lists the schemes it needs together; an empty alternative means no authentication. Without the field, the runtime sends no credentials.

parseAs.description: How to read a response body. auto decides from the actual Content-Type. events reads Server-Sent Events one by one, jsonLines and jsonSeq read JSON Lines and JSON text sequences item by item; a generator emits them only for a runtime that declares them, and stream otherwise.

contentType.description: A parameter given with content, serialized with this media type.

type.description: TypeDef of the value, for runtimes that convert with TypeDefs (design.md 18.7). Other runtimes ignore it.
TypeDef of the value, for runtimes that convert with TypeDefs (design.md 18.7). Other runtimes ignore it.

contentTypes.description: parseAs per media type, when the media types of a status are read differently.

jsonEvents.description: With events: the names of the events whose data is parsed as JSON, or true for every event. The data of other events stays a string.

readWithContentType.description: With none: a body that arrives with a Content-Type is read anyway, as auto reads it. For responses the definition gives no content; a runtime that does not support it discards the body.

types.description: TypeDef of the body per media type, for runtimes that convert with TypeDefs.

securityUse.description: A security scheme an alternative uses, with what the runtime needs to place the credential.

scheme.description: The name in components.securitySchemes; passed to the runtime's auth hook.

name.description: apiKey: the header, query or cookie name.

httpScheme.description: http: the Authorization scheme, such as bearer or basic.
